name.value: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Oyster Bay Ladysmith

description.value: A Wyndham-branded budget hotel situated on the Trans-Canada Highway at Oyster Bay, just outside Ladysmith on Vancouver Island. Part of the Microtel Inn & Suites chain, it offers a roadside overnight option on the busy Island corridor. Touring cyclists riding the Trans-Canada between Victoria and Nanaimo will find it a convenient stop along a stretch with limited accommodation. The hotel is majority-owned by the Stz'uminus First Nation and stands on Stz'uminus land.
